notes: Protocol fixed on development data (EF_DEV_RESULTS.md, RESEARCH_PLAN.md D14-D18).

protocol.context_limit_check: verified 2026-11-08 with synthetic prompts on this build and Qwen3.5-9B: a 34768-token prompt is refused with error type exceed_context_size_error; a 31868-token prompt stops generation at 32768 total tokens with finish_reason length (truncation), without context shifting
protocol.decoding: temperature 0, thinking off, prompt cache off, one user message
protocol.estimand: end-to-end relation-judgment performance under this protocol, output failures included (D18)
protocol.failures: truncation, parse failure and context refusal (server error type exceed_context_size_error) are terminal outcomes of a request: no prediction, stored and replayed on resume; no repair or re-query
protocol.metrics: micro recall on both corpora; precision and F1 on BioRED only; paper-level paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261107; delta 0.05 four-way reading on the interval of each comparison
protocol.no_changes_after_e4: no change of context size, chunking, format or any setting after E4 outcomes are seen
protocol.operational_failures: server or transport errors stop the run before the affected paper is recorded; the run is resumed from the answer cache after the server is fixed, and every start is journaled
protocol.output: JSON for every form and both models; minimal instruction; paragraph-level passages
protocol.primary_family: canonical reading, pairwise minus joint: recall (BioRED, BioTriplex) and precision (BioRED), per model: 6 contrasts, Bonferroni interval level 1 - 0.05/6 = 0.99167
protocol.provider_block_retry: exception to no re-query: the code retries a provider refusal once, identically; a second refusal is a terminal no-prediction outcome; the local server refused no request in development; any retry is reported
protocol.readings: primary: canonical spellings; strict reading reported alongside as a descriptive sensitivity analysis
protocol.secondary: descriptive: F1 at the level of its comparison config (0.99167 in pairwise-versus-joint configs); Qwen pairwise minus chunked and full text minus abstract (pairwise) at 0.95; strict-reading results; failure counts
